title: Matthew Chapter 28 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Matthew chapter 28 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Matthew Chapter 28 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Matthew Chapter 28.

questions.question: Who came to see the sepulchre at dawn on the first day of the week?
options: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
questions.correctAnswer: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
questions.explanation: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the sepulchre as stated in Matthew 28:1.

questions.question: What event occurred when the angel of the Lord descended from heaven?
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:2 mentions that there was a great earthquake when the angel descended.

questions.question: How did the countenance of the angel appear?
questions.explanation: The angel's countenance was described as being like lightning in Matthew 28:3.

questions.question: What happened to the keepers of the sepulchre when they saw the angel?
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:4 states that the keepers did shake and became as dead men due to fear.

questions.question: True or False: The angel told the women to fear not.
questions.explanation: The angel told the women to fear not in Matthew 28:5.

questions.question: What did the angel say to the women regarding Jesus?
options: He is still in the tomb
questions.explanation: The angel proclaimed that Jesus is risen, as stated in Matthew 28:6.

questions.question: What instructions did the angel give to the women?
options: To go quickly and tell his disciples
questions.correctAnswer: To go quickly and tell his disciples
questions.explanation: The angel instructed the women to go quickly and tell the disciples that Jesus is risen in Matthew 28:7.

questions.question: True or False: The women departed from the sepulchre with fear and no joy.
questions.explanation: The women left with fear and great joy as stated in Matthew 28:8.

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the women when he met them?
questions.explanation: When Jesus met the women, he greeted them with 'All hail' as stated in Matthew 28:9.

questions.question: True or False: The disciples were told to meet Jesus in Jerusalem.
questions.explanation: The disciples were told to go into Galilee to see Jesus, not Jerusalem, as stated in Matthew 28:10.

questions.question: In what location did the eleven disciples go to meet Jesus?
questions.explanation: The eleven disciples went away into Galilee where Jesus had appointed them, as stated in Matthew 28:16.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about his power?
options: All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth
It is only for his disciples
questions.correctAnswer: All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth
questions.explanation: Jesus declared that all power is given unto him in heaven and in earth in Matthew 28:18.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus commanded the disciples to teach only the Jews.
questions.explanation: Jesus commanded the disciples to teach all nations, not just the Jews, as stated in Matthew 28:19.

questions.question: What promise did Jesus give to his disciples?
options: He is with them always, even to the end of the world
questions.correctAnswer: He is with them always, even to the end of the world
questions.explanation: Jesus promised to be with his disciples always, as stated in Matthew 28:20.

questions.question: In Matthew 28, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
questions.explanation: The instruction 'Fear not' was given by the angel before all others in the chapter, specifically in Matthew 28:5.

medium.title: Matthew Chapter 28 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Matthew Chapter 28 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did the angel tell the women to do after announcing Jesus' resurrection?
options: Go quickly and tell his disciples
questions.correctAnswer: Go quickly and tell his disciples
questions.explanation: The angel instructed the women to go quickly and tell the disciples that Jesus is risen and will meet them in Galilee (Matthew 28:7).

questions.question: How did the women feel when they left the sepulchre?
questions.explanation: The women departed with fear and great joy after witnessing the resurrection (Matthew 28:8).

questions.question: What did the soldiers do when they encountered the angel?
questions.explanation: The keepers shook for fear of the angel and became as dead men (Matthew 28:4).

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the women when he met them?
questions.explanation: Jesus greeted the women with 'Be not afraid' when he met them (Matthew 28:10).

questions.question: What were the chief priests and elders doing when the soldiers reported the resurrection?
questions.explanation: The chief priests and elders were assembled and taking counsel after the soldiers reported the events (Matthew 28:12).

questions.question: What did the soldiers receive for spreading the false report about the resurrection?
questions.explanation: The chief priests and elders gave large money unto the soldiers to spread the false report (Matthew 28:12).

questions.question: What was the message the soldiers were told to spread?
questions.explanation: The soldiers were instructed to say that the disciples came by night and stole Jesus away while they slept (Matthew 28:13).

questions.question: How does the interaction between the women and Jesus illustrate the virtue of faith?
options: They held him by the feet and worshipped him
questions.correctAnswer: They held him by the feet and worshipped him
questions.explanation: The women's actions of worship demonstrate their faith in Jesus' resurrection and acknowledgment of his authority (Matthew 28:9).

questions.question: How does Matthew 28:18 emphasize Jesus' authority?
options: He has authority only in heaven
All power is given unto him in heaven and earth
He shares authority with the disciples
He delegates authority to the angels
questions.correctAnswer: All power is given unto him in heaven and earth
questions.explanation: Jesus claims that all power is given to him in both heaven and earth, emphasizing his ultimate authority (Matthew 28:18).

questions.question: True or False: The women were instructed to remain silent about Jesus' resurrection until they saw him again.
questions.explanation: The women were commanded to tell the disciples that Jesus had risen, demonstrating the importance of sharing the good news (Matthew 28:7).

questions.question: True or False: The soldiers were rewarded for their honesty regarding the events at the tomb.
questions.explanation: The soldiers were paid to spread a false story about Jesus’ resurrection, indicating a lack of integrity (Matthew 28:12-13).

questions.question: True or False: Jesus promised to be with his disciples until the end of the world.
questions.explanation: Jesus assured his disciples that he would be with them always, emphasizing his constant presence and support (Matthew 28:20).

hard.title: Matthew Chapter 28 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Matthew Chapter 28.

questions.question: What did the angel tell the women who came to the sepulchre?
options: He is not here: for he is risen
questions.correctAnswer: He is not here: for he is risen
questions.explanation: The angel informed the women that Jesus was not there because He had risen, as noted in Matthew 28:6.

questions.question: How did the keepers of the sepulchre react to the angel?
questions.explanation: The keepers shook with fear and became as dead men when they saw the angel, as described in Matthew 28:4.

questions.question: What were the women instructed to do after encountering the angel?
options: Tell the disciples He is risen
questions.correctAnswer: Tell the disciples He is risen
questions.explanation: The angel instructed the women to go quickly and tell the disciples that Jesus is risen, according to Matthew 28:7.

questions.question: What was the reaction of the women as they left the sepulchre?
options: They were filled with fear and great joy
questions.correctAnswer: They were filled with fear and great joy
questions.explanation: The women departed with both fear and great joy after the angel's message, as detailed in Matthew 28:8.

questions.question: What did Jesus say when He met the women on their way to tell the disciples?
questions.explanation: When Jesus met the women, He said, 'Be not afraid,' as seen in Matthew 28:10.

questions.question: What did the soldiers report to the chief priests?
questions.explanation: The soldiers reported to the chief priests that they should say the disciples came by night and stole Jesus away, as indicated in Matthew 28:13.

questions.question: What did the eleven disciples do after hearing the news of Jesus' resurrection?
questions.explanation: The eleven disciples went into Galilee, as appointed by Jesus, according to Matthew 28:16.

questions.question: When the disciples saw Jesus in Galilee, what was their response?
questions.explanation: When the disciples saw Jesus, they worshipped Him, although some doubted, as stated in Matthew 28:17.

questions.question: According to Jesus in Matthew 28:18, what has been given to Him?
questions.explanation: Jesus declared that all power is given unto Him in heaven and in earth in Matthew 28:18.

questions.question: In Matthew 28:19, what are the disciples commanded to do?
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed the disciples to go and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, according to Matthew 28:19.

questions.question: True or False: The saying about Jesus' disciples stealing His body is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
questions.explanation: It is stated in Matthew 28:15 that this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus promised to be with His disciples only until the end of the week.
questions.explanation: Jesus promised to be with His disciples alway, even unto the end of the world, as noted in Matthew 28:20.

questions.question: Which Old Testament theme is echoed in Matthew 28:19's command to baptize all nations?
questions.explanation: The command to baptize all nations reflects the Great Commission theme, which emphasizes spreading the faith to all peoples, seen also in Mark 16:15.

questions.question: What literary device is evident in the statement 'All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth'?
questions.explanation: This statement uses parallelism by contrasting 'heaven' and 'earth' to emphasize the extent of Jesus' authority in Matthew 28:18.

questions.question: What is the Greek word for 'power' used in Matthew 28:18, and what does it signify?
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'exousia' signifies authority, which is the context of Jesus' statement in Matthew 28:18.

theological.title: Matthew Chapter 28 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Matthew Chapter 28 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Matthew 28:6 reveal about the resurrection of Jesus?
options: He is not here: for he is risen
He is still in the grave
He will rise in three days
He was taken up into heaven
questions.correctAnswer: He is not here: for he is risen
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:6 clearly states that Jesus is no longer in the grave, emphasizing the central Christian doctrine of the resurrection. This event confirms Jesus' victory over death and sin, a theme seen throughout the New Testament (1 Corinthians 15:55-57).

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated by the angel rolling back the stone?
questions.explanation: The act of the angel rolling back the stone (Matthew 28:2) showcases God's omnipotence, illustrating His supreme power over natural events and death itself, as seen in Job 42:2.

questions.question: What did the angel instruct the women to do after they found the empty tomb?
options: Tell his disciples he has risen
questions.correctAnswer: Tell his disciples he has risen
questions.explanation: In Matthew 28:7, the angel commands the women to go quickly and inform the disciples of Jesus' resurrection, highlighting the importance of sharing the good news of the Gospel.

questions.question: How does the reaction of the guards to the angel's appearance illustrate the nature of fear?
options: They shook and became as dead men
questions.correctAnswer: They shook and became as dead men
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:4 describes the guards' fear as they shook and became like dead men in the presence of the angel, illustrating the overwhelming power of divine interventions.

questions.question: What does Matthew 28:19 teach about the Great Commission?
options: It is only for the disciples
It includes baptizing in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost
It should be done in secret
questions.correctAnswer: It includes baptizing in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:19 outlines the command to baptize in the name of the Trinity, emphasizing the importance of the Great Commission in the spread of the Christian faith.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth' signify about Jesus' authority?
options: He is the sovereign ruler over all creation
He shares power with the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: He is the sovereign ruler over all creation
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:18 reveals that Jesus possesses all authority in heaven and earth, signifying His divine sovereignty and lordship, a key element in Christology.

questions.question: In Matthew 28:10, what does Jesus instruct the women to tell His brethren?
questions.explanation: In Matthew 28:10, Jesus tells the women to inform His disciples to go to Galilee, where they will see Him, emphasizing His ongoing relationship with His followers.

questions.question: What is the significance of the earthquake in Matthew 28:2?
options: It shows the power of the angel
It indicates a change in the heavens
questions.correctAnswer: It shows the power of the angel
questions.explanation: The earthquake described in Matthew 28:2 serves as a dramatic sign of the angel's descent and the momentous event of the resurrection, aligning with divine presence in biblical events (Psalm 114:7).

questions.question: What does Matthew 28:15 reveal about the response of the chief priests to the resurrection?
options: They bribed the soldiers to spread a false narrative
They sought to silence the disciples
questions.correctAnswer: They bribed the soldiers to spread a false narrative
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:12-13 shows that the chief priests conspired to spread a false story about Jesus' body being stolen, highlighting the lengths to which they would go to deny the truth of the resurrection.

questions.question: What does the command to 'teach all nations' in Matthew 28:19 emphasize about the mission of the church?
options: It is limited to local communities
questions.explanation: The command in Matthew 28:19 emphasizes that the Gospel is to be proclaimed to all nations, reflecting the inclusive nature of salvation as expressed in Acts 1:8.

questions.question: How does Matthew 28:17 address doubt among the disciples?
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:17 acknowledges that while some disciples worshipped Jesus, others doubted, illustrating the human struggle with faith even in the presence of the resurrected Christ.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world' in Matthew 28:20 convey about God's presence?
options: God's presence is eternal and constant
Only the Holy Spirit is present
questions.correctAnswer: God's presence is eternal and constant
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:20 assures believers of Jesus' continual presence, emphasizing the doctrine of God's omnipresence and His commitment to His followers, as also seen in Hebrews 13:5.

questions.question: What doctrinal insight can be drawn from combining Matthew 28:7 and Matthew 28:19?
options: The resurrection is for a select few
The resurrection should not be shared
The resurrection is the basis for the Great Commission
questions.correctAnswer: The resurrection is the basis for the Great Commission
questions.explanation: Together, Matthew 28:7 and 28:19 illustrate that the resurrection of Jesus is foundational for the mission to spread the Gospel, as it empowers the call to baptize and teach all nations.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Matthew 28:5-6 and Matthew 28:14 convey about the nature of truth?
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:5-6 reveals the truth of the resurrection, while Matthew 28:14 shows how the chief priests sought to manipulate this truth for their own ends, highlighting the conflict between divine truth and human deception.

questions.question: Skeptics claim the resurrection is a myth. What does Matthew 28:1-10 teach about the event?
options: It was witnessed by multiple individuals
It was only reported by one person
questions.correctAnswer: It was witnessed by multiple individuals
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:1-10 provides an account of the resurrection that includes multiple witnesses, such as Mary Magdalene and the other Mary, which supports the claim of its historical validity.
